scope: Exact draft prompt clarification only; no whole-extraction, chapter chronology, source-semantic, publication or production-run approval.
assessment: Full prompt lacks the supported undated representation and its opening universal Western-date requirement needs the explicit exception. Compact prompt already mentions the marker but universal opening and final-audit hint requirements contradict it. The proposed changes resolve those contradictions without changing promptVersion 7, schema, runtime or validator.

Exact-master validateAttestationClaim allows undatedSourceAttestation only as true, requires a trimmed event length of at least 20, and rejects sourceDate, qualitative, westernYear/westernInterval/westernBounds, unresolved (including false), and unresolvedReason on the marked attestation. The proposed field instructions match.

For the undated-only exception, exact-master gates require at least one attestation, all attestations marked true, and no person claim value with date-bearing chronology. hasDateBearingChronology recursively finds sourceDate, qualitative, unresolved and Western representations outside explicit undated containers. The proposed [] instruction states this exact exception rather than broadening it to mixed chronology. Other existing reception/death/unresolved/life-chronology exceptions are outside this minimal draft.

Nested dateContext is validated with validateAttestationClaim, so preserving an undated age plus reckoning and the marker/event in dateContext is supported. Compact a directly expands to identityHints.activeDateHints; both schema arrays allow empty arrays. No unsupported flag, JSON shape or conversion mechanism is introduced.

The added instructions require checking all supplied evidence and inherited context, preserve facts/ages/relative event sequences, retain genuine source periods and conversion/event-owner/conflicting-witness holds, and retain supported bounds. They prohibit fabricated calendar/birth/reign-wide activity dates and do not authorize blanket chronology clearing. Existing candidate, mention, evidence, factual coverage, reception ownership, and independent date audit requirements remain in place.

Independently reconstructed each exact-master before/after prompt from the declared substitutions, verified paragraph/file/per-file-patch/combined-patch/manifest/reference hashes, and replayed the 11 helper/gate assertions against exact git-show source with output redirected only to this reviewer artifact directory. Replayed evidence equals the supplied contract evidence.
limitations: The eleven assertions test extracted attestation/date-bearing helper and gate logic in memory. They do not validate a whole packet/extraction, source facts, independent audit completeness or semantic absence of dates.

The marker short-circuits hasDateBearingChronology; production attestation validation separately prohibits coexisting date fields. Structural acceptance is not evidence that an actual source context is genuinely undated. Independent source review remains mandatory.
No live prompts, runtime, chapter/source files, queue claims, recovery state, Git index/branch or runner state were changed. No external model calls or builds were made.
